# Sex Assigned at Birth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-SexAssignedAtBirth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SexAssignedAtBirth>
- **Category:** class

A recorded sex-assigned-at-birth value pointed at by [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](../properties/gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md) — a VALUE, never a subclass. Deliberately coarse and inclusive (incl. intersex); finer sex-characteristic detail is an optional free-text [`gmeow:intersexVariation`](../properties/gmeow-intersexVariation.md) note, not a clinical taxonomy.
